title: Starter pack missed risk acceptance links

trigger.signal: Missing risk acceptance links in sample records

impact.user_impact: Risk acceptance examples could drift from enforcement expectations.

root_cause.summary: Starter pack omitted risk acceptance and mistake records, leaving enforcement examples incomplete.

fix.summary: Add risk acceptance, mistake records, and learnings index to the starter pack.

prevent_rule.statement: Decision records must reference existing Mistake Records and guardrail IDs declared by those Mistake Records.
prevent_rule.rationale: Ensures prevention rules are traceable and enforceable.

do_not: Do not declare guardrails without a corresponding Mistake Record
Do not skip mistake validation during enforcement checks
prefer: Validate guardrail IDs against Mistake Records
Keep mistake links current when risks are accepted
